title: Seat
description: One lobby seat. Held on the game state itself, so the lobby is a game phase rather than server infrastructure.

joined.description: Set by the in-game sitDown move. A seat reserved through the lobby REST join but not yet sat down is named and not joined.

name.description: Display name, supplied at the lobby REST join. Empty string on a free seat.

color.description: Claimed colour, or null before pickColor. Uniqueness across seats is enforced by the move handler.

avatar.description: Claimed avatar emoji from the eight-item AVATARS set, or null before pickAvatar. Unique across seats.

ready.description: Toggled by toggleReady. The host's start move requires every joined seat to be ready.

ai.description: True when the seat is driven by the MCP session rather than a human. Source of truth for the client's bot badge; omitted or false means human.
